sources.name: Claude DEC-227 analysis
sources.detail: Token Aristocrats Drain, recursion-heavy, B3 Focused Fair open-budget polish. 8 plan revisions, board-approved 2026-05-13. Emergent Plunderer + Reassembling Skeleton + Ashnod's Altar + drain combo line.

sources.name: DEC-281 Scryfall+EDHREC re-audit
sources.detail: 2026-05-19 board-approved 5 swaps: Karmic Guide→Teysa Karlov (death-trigger doubler), Fellwar Stone→Deadly Dispute (casualty instant draw+treasure), Cruel Celebrant→Dark Prophecy (passive draw on death), Grim Tutor→Plumb the Forbidden (mass-sac draw), Generous Gift→Clever Concealment (instant convoke phase-out for protection; non-GC so bracket stays 3).

guideContent.strategyOverview: Silverquill, the Disputant grants every instant or sorcery you cast Casualty 1 — sacrifice any creature with power 1 or greater to copy the spell with new targets. The deck pairs this engine with a token-aristocrats backbone: token generators (Bitterblossom, Ophiomancer, Hidden Stockpile, Bastion of Remembrance, Pawn of Ulamog, Pitiless Plunderer, Sedgemoor Witch) and a deep recursion package (Bloodghast, Reassembling Skeleton, Nether Traitor, Forsaken Miner, Infestation Sage, Timeline Culler) keep an endless supply of 1- to 2-power bodies for casualty fodder. Sedgemoor Witch's magecraft makes a 1/1 Pest on every cast AND every casualty-copy — two Pests per casualty spell, guaranteed. Sacrifices feed stacked drain payoffs — Blood Artist, Zulaport Cutthroat, Marionette Apprentice, Elas il-Kor, Bastion of Remembrance, Grave Venerations, and Kambal (Profiteering Mayor) — and Teysa Karlov doubles each death trigger for 12-20 incremental drains per turn cycle once the engine is online. Kambal layers a token-ETB drain on top of the death-trigger drains, so every token enters → drain 1, then sacs → drain 1 again. Casualty doubles every removal spell, every tutor, every reanimation sorcery (Reanimate, Living Death), and most importantly every X-drain finisher (Exsanguinate, Debt to the Deathless). Bloodletter of Aclazotz doubles all opponent life loss on your turn, so an X=8 Exsanguinate copied via casualty becomes 32 life lost per opponent. Grand Crescendo (instant: X tokens + indestructible to your creatures) gives the engine a wrath-proof window. Blot Out the Sky scales as a third X-finisher: at X=6 + casualty, 12 flying 2/1 Inklings plus a non-creature/non-land wipe — closes games while clearing stax pieces. Elspeth, Storm Slayer doubles every token entering under your control (Bitterblossom faeries, Ophiomancer snakes, Sedgemoor Pests, Plunderer treasures) and defends herself via her 0-ability (+1/+1 + flying to all creatures EOT, zero loyalty cost) from a starting loyalty of 5. Backup wins: emergent Pitiless Plunderer + Reassembling Skeleton + Ashnod's Altar + drain infinite, Westvale Abbey transforming into Ormendahl, and 4/4 flying-vigilance commander combat. No dedicated combo line — combos emerge from synergistic aristocrats cards.

winConditions.title: X-Drain Finishers
winConditions.description: Primary win condition. Cast Exsanguinate for X=8 with Bloodletter of Aclazotz on board: each opp loses 16. Casualty copies the spell: each opp loses 32. Lethal across a 3-opponent table from 40 life. Debt to the Deathless is the redundant copy at slightly higher cost (X+1 per cast).

winConditions.title: Plunderer + Skeleton + Ashnod's Altar combo (emergent)
winConditions.description: Emergent 3-card mana loop + drain trigger. Sacrifice Reassembling Skeleton on Ashnod's Altar (+CC); Pitiless Plunderer triggers and makes a Treasure (1 mana of any color); pay {1}{B} (1 from Altar + B from Treasure) to recur Reassembling Skeleton from graveyard. Net +1 mana per loop and a drain trigger fires per Blood Artist / Zulaport Cutthroat / Bastion of Remembrance / Marionette Apprentice / Grave Venerations / Elas il-Kor on board (Teysa Karlov doubles each). Infinite drain. None of the pieces is dedicated combo glue — Plunderer / Skeleton / Altar each have standalone value. Tutorable via Enlightened Tutor (Altar), Beseech the Mirror (≤4 cmc free-cast — Plunderer is 4 cmc, Skeleton is 2 cmc), Diabolic Intent, Buried Alive (Skeleton).

winConditions.title: Incremental Aristocrat Drain (Teysa-doubled)
winConditions.description: 6 stacked drain triggers fire off 4-6 creature deaths/turn from token generators + recursion creatures, each doubled by Teysa Karlov when active. Effective drain per death = 8-12 life across each opponent depending on surviving payoffs. Grindy attrition win in ~5-7 turns with Teysa, ~6-8 turns without. Resilient: drain triggers spread across creatures and enchantments, hard to remove all at once.

winConditions.title: Commander combat (back-up)
winConditions.description: 4/4 flying vigilance can swing in 5-6 times for 21 commander damage to one opponent. Vigilance keeps the commander available for defensive blocking on the same turn.

winConditions.title: Ormendahl line (back-up)
winConditions.description: Sacrifice 5 creatures + pay 5 mana on Westvale Abbey to transform into Ormendahl, Profane Prince — 9/7 flying lifelink indestructible haste finisher. With our recursion package, sacrificing 5 creatures barely dents the board.

synergies.title: Casualty doubles every instant and sorcery
synergies.description: Silverquill's commander text grants Casualty 1 to every instant and sorcery you cast. Sacrifice a 1-power creature → copy the spell with new targets. Twin removal, twin tutors, twin reanimations, twin X-drains. The casualty cost is so cheap (any 1/1 token) that it should fire on virtually every I/S after turn 3.

synergies.title: Self-replenishing recursion fodder
synergies.description: Six 1- to 2-power black creatures that recur from the graveyard via different triggers — landfall, mana payment, creature-death, crime, ETB-token, and warp. Sacrificing them for casualty + sac outlets + drain payoffs is essentially free; the bodies return next turn.

synergies.title: Forsaken Miner crime recursion
synergies.description: Every targeted removal and every Bojuka Bog activation is a crime. With ~10-12 crime triggers per game, Forsaken Miner recurs from the graveyard for {B} multiple times per turn cycle — effectively turning every spot-removal into +1 body on board.

synergies.title: Stacked drain payoff redundancy (Teysa-doubled)
synergies.description: 6 stacked drain payoffs trigger 'when a creature you control dies, opp loses life'. Teysa Karlov makes each one trigger an additional time, effectively doubling output to 12 drains per board state. Even if 2-3 payoffs are removed across a game, the engine stays online. Marionette Apprentice extends the trigger to artifact deaths (Treasures, Servos); Grave Venerations layers monarch + recursion + drain.

synergies.title: Bloodletter doubles X-drain finishers
synergies.description: Bloodletter of Aclazotz: 'If an opponent would lose life during your turn, they lose twice that much life instead.' Exsanguinate for X=8 with Bloodletter on board: each opp loses 16. Casualty copies the spell: each opp loses 32 total. Lethal threshold.

synergies.title: Sedgemoor Witch + Casualty engine
synergies.description: Sedgemoor Witch's Magecraft triggers 'whenever you cast or copy an instant or sorcery'. Every Silverquill-cast spell triggers Magecraft once on cast and again on the casualty copy — two 1/1 B/G Pest tokens per casualty spell, guaranteed. Each Pest has 'when this token dies, you gain 1 life'. Pests are perfect casualty fodder (1 power), feed every drain payoff on death, and stack with Teysa Karlov's death-trigger doubling. 3/2 menace body with Ward 3 life makes the engine sticky against pinpoint removal.

synergies.title: Kambal drains token entries (stacks with death drains)
synergies.description: Kambal triggers when one or more of your tokens enter — each opponent loses 1, you gain 1. Bitterblossom faeries (upkeep), Ophiomancer snakes (upkeep), Plunderer treasures (creature deaths), Stockpile Servos (turn), Bastion humans (ETB), Pawn of Ulamog spawns (creature deaths), and Sedgemoor Pests (per cast and copy) all trigger Kambal once per turn. Token enters (Kambal: drain 1) → sac → Blood Artist/Zulaport/etc (drain 1 again). Teysa doesn't double Kambal (not a 'dies' trigger) but Kambal is a new drain layer on a 2/4 body. Second mode: when an opponent's token enters, make a tapped copy under your control — token-deck neutralizer.

synergies.title: Grand Crescendo — protection + token burst
synergies.description: Grand Crescendo: {X}{W}{W} instant — create X 1/1 G/W Citizen tokens, all your creatures gain indestructible EOT. Fills the deck's only metric-flagged role gap (protection 1.0/2). Complementary protection mode to Clever Concealment: phasing (Concealment) dodges exile and sac, indestructible (Crescendo) dodges wraths at minimum {W}{W} on a hard cast (X=0). At X≥3 the spell also pumps the board with casualty fodder and casualty doubles X. Cast pre-wrath EOT for free indestructibility on the whole engine.

synergies.title: Blot Out the Sky — finisher with non-creature wipe
synergies.description: Blot Out the Sky: {X}{W}{B} sorcery — X tapped 2/1 W/B Inkling flying tokens; if X≥6, destroy all noncreature/nonland permanents. Cast at X=6 (8 mana) + casualty 1 → 12 flying 2/1 tokens + the wipe trigger fires (second wipe is redundant but the token output doubles). Third finisher alongside Exsanguinate and Debt to the Deathless — fills a unique role the deck previously lacked (non-creature board wipe). Self-collateral on the wipe is real (kills your own enchantment engines), so play as a closing card, not a midgame play.

synergies.title: Elspeth, Storm Slayer — global token doubler
synergies.description: Elspeth: {3}{W}{W} planeswalker, starting loyalty 5. Static replacement: 'If one or more tokens would be created under your control, twice that many of those tokens are created instead.' +1 makes a 1/1 Soldier (doubled to 2). 0 ability puts +1/+1 + flying on all creatures EOT (zero loyalty cost). −3 destroys creature MV≥3. Doubles every token source: Bitterblossom faeries become 2/upkeep, Ophiomancer snakes become 2/upkeep, Pawn of Ulamog spawns 2/creature-death, Plunderer treasures 2/creature-death, Bastion humans 2 on ETB, Sedgemoor Pests 2 per cast AND 2 per casualty-copy (4 Pests per casualty spell with Elspeth out).

synergies.title: Grave Venerations triple-duty
synergies.description: Grave Venerations ETB makes you the monarch (draw extra cards each end step while alive), end-step returns a creature card from GY to hand if you're still monarch, AND triggers as a drain payoff on creature deaths. Bitterblossom Faeries and Ophiomancer Snakes are credible monarch-defense chump blockers.

highlights.name: Silverquill, the Disputant
highlights.reason: Commander — 4/4 flying vigilance Elder Dragon that grants Casualty 1 to every instant and sorcery you cast. Twin-spell engine in WB Orzhov colors.

highlights.name: Necropotence
highlights.reason: Game Changer #1. Premier black draw engine — pay 1 life, exile top of library, draw it next end-of-turn cleanup. Scales with life total.

highlights.name: Smothering Tithe
highlights.reason: Game Changer #2. Treasure ramp on opponent draws — at competitive tables generates 2-4 Treasures per turn cycle. Essential WB ramp.

highlights.name: Enlightened Tutor
highlights.reason: Game Changer #3. 1-mana instant artifact/enchantment tutor. 17 valid targets in this deck (Animate Dead, Bitterblossom, Necropotence, Bastion, Smothering Tithe, etc.). Casualty doubles it.

highlights.name: Bloodletter of Aclazotz
highlights.reason: All opponent life loss on your turn is doubled. Turns Exsanguinate X=8 + casualty into 32-life-loss per opponent.

highlights.name: Ashnod's Altar
highlights.reason: Free sacrifice outlet that adds 2 colorless mana per sac. Combo piece in the emergent Plunderer + Skeleton + Altar + drain infinite (board-approved). Standalone: free sac outlet for casualty fodder.

highlights.name: Pitiless Plunderer
highlights.reason: Treasure on every creature death. Triple-role: ramp engine, sac fodder (1 power), and combo piece in the Ashnod's Altar + Skeleton loop.

highlights.name: Grave Venerations
highlights.reason: Triple-duty enchantment: monarch on ETB (draw extra cards), end-step recursion from GY to hand, and a Blood Artist-style drain trigger.

highlights.name: Forsaken Miner
highlights.reason: 1-mana 2/2 that recurs from GY for {B} whenever you commit a crime. Every targeted removal + every Bojuka Bog activation is a crime — fires nearly every turn cycle.

highlights.name: Westvale Abbey // Ormendahl, Profane Prince
highlights.reason: Land that taps for C, activates for a 1/1 W/B Human Cleric token (casualty fodder), and transforms via 5-sac into a 9/7 flying lifelink indestructible haste finisher.
